notice: Scope is owner-confirmed. Detailed requirements are proposed unless scope-derived; none is physically verified. Empty numeric targets/results remain pending.

requirements.requirement: Camera/inference/alerts have no application command path to ESC, steering, shift or RC receiver. Operator RC controls motion.
requirements.verification_method: Review software write paths and physical interfaces, then controlled auxiliary-off/fault observations with RC operation. Source inspection alone does not establish wiring.

requirements.requirement: Retain Uno acquisition and serial protocol 2 unless a separately reviewed sensor/interface change requires migration.
requirements.verification_method: Run original strict parser/null/session tests and match enabled-sensor build/config to real captured telemetry.

requirements.requirement: Capture the intended litter-view area and produce image-based detections using an identified camera and model.
requirements.verification_method: Inspect selected camera/FOV and evaluate annotated representative frames and actual runtime output. No model or camera is selected yet.

requirements.requirement: Establish camera/Pi/storage load and safe power/USB coexistence using actual equipment.
requirements.verification_method: Trace input/returns, labels and ratings; measure representative load behavior. No new fuse/converter value is assigned.
requirements.target_decision: Limits follow actual selected equipment and measured conditions.

requirements.requirement: Every inference outcome and alert traces to the correct run, camera/frame, source dimensions and host clock domain.
requirements.verification_method: Replay known frame IDs/timestamps and transforms, test drops/reconnects, verify original video frame mapping. No hardware synchronization claim.
requirements.target_decision: Choose an alignment error method/limit after timestamp experiments.

requirements.requirement: Healthy no-object output is distinct from failed, dropped, disabled or unavailable inference.
requirements.verification_method: Synthetic empty/error/drop cases plus real camera/model disconnects. Record model/class-map/preprocessing identity and validate box bounds.

requirements.requirement: Show fresh operator advisories with source and health status; expire stale alerts without issuing motion commands.
requirements.verification_method: Test delayed frames, failed inference, replay, viewer disconnect and recovery. An absent valid result is not an all-clear.
requirements.target_decision: Agree freshness/latency/alert grouping after camera/Pi benchmarks.

requirements.requirement: Preserve raw serial and original video plus context/frame/model/detection/alert records and explicit missing data.
requirements.verification_method: Inspect finalized run schema, file offsets/counts and capture/inference coverage; exercise normal stop and failures.
requirements.target_decision: Define coverage denominator and acceptable loss; no inherited 95% gate.

requirements.requirement: Acquisition/archive continue locally when the operator network/viewer disconnects; loss of live alerts is visible on reconnection.
requirements.verification_method: Controlled network loss/rejoin with local recording and missing-viewer events. No always-connected alert guarantee.

requirements.requirement: Training/evaluation labels, data splits, model artifacts and class maps have immutable identities; examples are not field evidence.
requirements.verification_method: Review annotation rubric, whole-session/location/day separation and independent evaluation. Record hashes/splits before fitting.
requirements.target_decision: Choose target classes, operating scenes and evaluation criteria before selecting models.

requirements.requirement: Operator starts/stops, verifies and transfers a finished run with context and destination checksum verification.
requirements.verification_method: Complete a real operator trial, inspect final status/sample counts and compare source/destination hashes.
requirements.target_decision: Agree required run metadata and an actual storage destination.

requirements.requirement: Camera/inference/viewer cannot silently starve telemetry or fill storage under the selected runtime load.
requirements.verification_method: Concurrent benchmark and low-disk/camera/model fault trials on the actual Pi. Record CPU temperature, disk, timing and dropped work.
requirements.target_decision: Select budgets only after Pi/camera/model identity and benchmark evidence.

requirements.requirement: Camera/mount/cables preserve the confirmed frame/tub relationships and allow required sightlines, access and motion.
requirements.verification_method: Measured fit and FOV observations, tub tipping and suspension/steering/cable clearance checks. No numeric measurement is inherited from layout CAD.
requirements.target_decision: Select camera datum and measure affected interfaces/travel.

requirements.requirement: State actual detection/data/alert performance on independent representative runs before declaring the assisted V3 capability validated.
requirements.verification_method: Agree numeric criteria, evaluate held-out runs and demonstrate real-board latency and operator usefulness.
requirements.target_decision: All numerical acceptance values remain unselected; no readiness score is fabricated.

requirements.requirement: Vehicle V3, Uno R3 hardware, firmware ID, JSON protocol 2 and model/dataset versions are recorded independently.
requirements.verification_method: Inspect config/model/run manifests and backward compatibility. Do not retag a V2 replay or unknown deployed firmware as verified V3.

requirements.requirement: Camera/model/logger/storage failure is recorded and recoverable while preserving manual RC authority and original evidence.
requirements.verification_method: Controlled stop/restart/unplug/low-disk cases, separate valid/failed/unfinished run status and an operator recovery trial. No physical tests yet performed.
